title: Quadratic eigenvector of the one-shelf position matrix
outcome: For every n>=3, the exact source quadratic is a nonzero eigenvector with eigenvalue 1/4; geometric multiplicity at least one.
novelty: Known mathematical result: special case of Tripathi, arXiv:2602.07920v1, Theorem I. New-to-this-package Lean verification; no priority claim.
